pub fn set_times_nofollow<P: AsRef<Path>>(
    path: P,
    times: FileTimes,
) -> Result<()>

children.value: Changes the timestamps of the file or symlink at the specified path.
This function will attempt to set the access and modification times to the times specified. Differ from
, if the path refers to a symbolic link, this function will change the timestamps of the symlink itself, not the target file.

This function will return an error if the user lacks permission to change timestamps on the target file or symlink. It may also return an error if the OS does not support it.
